[Wed 2026-05-20 11:40 UTC] Detail the parameters and descriptions for each available tool.

[[reply_to_current]] Available tools in this session, with their purposes and main parameters:

## File tools

### `read`
Read file contents.

**Purpose**
- Read text files.
- Can also read image files like JPG/PNG/GIF/WebP as attachments.
- Output is truncated for large files unless offsets are used.

**Parameters**
- `path` / `file_path`: file path to read.
- `offset`: starting line number, 1-indexed.
- `limit`: maximum number of lines to read.

---

### `write`
Create or overwrite a file.

**Purpose**
- Writes content to a file.
- Creates parent directories automatically.
- Overwrites existing files.

**Parameters**
- `path` / `file_path`: target file path.
- `content`: full file content to write.

---

### `edit`
Precisely edit a file by replacing exact text.

**Purpose**
- Surgical edits only.
- Requires the old text to match exactly.

**Parameters**
- `path` / `file_path`: file to edit.
- `oldText` / `old_string`: exact text to replace.
- `newText` / `new_string`: replacement text.

---

## Shell / process tools

### `exec`
Run shell commands.

**Purpose**
- Execute commands in the workspace or another working directory.
- Can run interactively with a pseudo-terminal.
- Can background long-running commands.

**Parameters**
- `command`: shell command to run.
- `workdir`: working directory.
- `yieldMs`: how long to wait before backgrounding.
- `background`: run in background immediately.
- `timeout`: timeout in seconds.
- `pty`: allocate a pseudo-terminal.
- `elevated`: request elevated permissions if available.
- `host`: execution host: `sandbox`, `gateway`, or `node`.
- `security`: security mode: `deny`, `allowlist`, or `full`.
- `ask`: approval mode: `off`, `on-miss`, or `always`.
- `node`: node id/name when running on a paired node.

---

### `process`
Manage running `exec` sessions.

**Purpose**
- Poll background commands.
- Send input to interactive commands.
- Read logs.
- Kill processes.

**Parameters**
- `action`: one of `list`, `poll`, `log`, `write`, `send-keys`, `submit`, `paste`, `kill`.
- `sessionId`: process/session id.
- `data`: text to write to stdin.
- `keys`: key tokens to send.
- `hex`: raw hex bytes to send.
- `literal`: literal string for key sending.
- `text`: text to paste.
- `bracketed`: use bracketed paste mode.
- `eof`: close stdin after writing.
- `offset`: log offset.
- `limit`: log length.
- `timeout`: polling timeout in milliseconds.

---

## Web tools

### `web_search`
Search the web using Brave Search.

**Purpose**
- Fast web search.
- Returns titles, URLs, and snippets.

**Parameters**
- `query`: search query.
- `count`: number of results, 1–10.
- `country`: region code, e.g. `US`, `DE`, `ALL`.
- `language`: ISO language code.
- `freshness`: `day`, `week`, `month`, or `year`.
- `date_after`: only results after `YYYY-MM-DD`.
- `date_before`: only results before `YYYY-MM-DD`.
- `search_lang`: Brave search language, e.g. `en`, `en-gb`.
- `ui_lang`: UI locale, e.g. `en-US`.

---

### `web_fetch`
Fetch and extract readable content from a URL.

**Purpose**
- Lightweight page fetching without browser automation.
- Converts HTML to markdown or text.

**Parameters**
- `url`: HTTP/HTTPS URL.
- `extractMode`: `markdown` or `text`.
- `maxChars`: maximum returned characters.

---

## Browser / UI tools

### `browser`
Control a browser session.

**Purpose**
- Open/navigate pages.
- Inspect tabs.
- Take snapshots/screenshots.
- Interact with web UI.
- Use host Chrome relay or isolated OpenClaw browser.

**Primary parameters**
- `action`: one of:
  - `status`
  - `start`
  - `stop`
  - `profiles`
  - `tabs`
  - `open`
  - `focus`
  - `close`
  - `snapshot`
  - `screenshot`
  - `navigate`
  - `console`
  - `pdf`
  - `upload`
  - `dialog`
  - `act`
- `target`: `sandbox`, `host`, or `node`.
- `node`: node id/name.
- `profile`: browser profile, usually `chrome` or `openclaw`.
- `url`: URL to navigate/open.
- `targetUrl`: URL filter/target.
- `targetId`: specific browser tab/page id.
- `limit`: max results.
- `maxChars`: max snapshot/console output.
- `mode`: e.g. `efficient`.
- `snapshotFormat`: `aria` or `ai`.
- `refs`: `role` or `aria`.
- `interactive`: whether interactive snapshot is wanted.
- `compact`: compact output.
- `depth`: DOM/snapshot depth.
- `selector`: CSS selector.
- `frame`: frame selector/ref.
- `labels`: include labels.
- `fullPage`: full-page screenshot.
- `type`: screenshot type: `png` or `jpeg`.
- `level`: console log level.
- `paths`: upload file paths.
- `inputRef`: upload input ref.
- `timeoutMs`: timeout.

**Interaction parameters for `action: "act"`**
- `kind`: `click`, `type`, `press`, `hover`, `drag`, `select`, `fill`, `resize`, `wait`, `evaluate`, or `close`.
- `ref`: element reference.
- `element`: human-readable element description.
- `doubleClick`: double-click instead of click.
- `button`: mouse button.
- `modifiers`: keyboard modifiers.
- `text`: text to type/fill.
- `submit`: submit after typing.
- `slowly`: type slowly.
- `key`: keyboard key to press.
- `delayMs`: delay.
- `startRef`: drag start element.
- `endRef`: drag target element.
- `values`: select values.
- `fields`: multiple fill fields.
- `width` / `height`: resize dimensions.
- `timeMs`: wait duration.
- `textGone`: wait until text disappears.
- `loadState`: wait for load state.
- `fn`: JS function for evaluate.
- `request`: nested action request object.

---

### `canvas`
Control node canvases.

**Purpose**
- Present or hide a canvas.
- Navigate canvas to a URL.
- Evaluate JavaScript.
- Capture snapshots.
- Push A2UI data.

**Parameters**
- `action`: `present`, `hide`, `navigate`, `eval`, `snapshot`, `a2ui_push`, or `a2ui_reset`.
- `gatewayUrl`: gateway URL override.
- `gatewayToken`: gateway auth token.
- `timeoutMs`: timeout.
- `node`: target node.
- `target`: target display/canvas.
- `x`, `y`, `width`, `height`: placement/size.
- `url`: URL to show.
- `javaScript`: JS to evaluate.
- `outputFormat`: `png`, `jpg`, or `jpeg`.
- `maxWidth`: max snapshot width.
- `quality`: image quality.
- `delayMs`: delay before capture.
- `jsonl`: A2UI JSONL payload.
- `jsonlPath`: path to A2UI JSONL file.

---

## Node/device tools

### `nodes`
Discover and control paired nodes.

**Purpose**
- Check node status.
- Pair/approve/reject nodes.
- Send device notifications.
- Use cameras/photos/screens/location.
- Inspect notifications/device health.
- Run commands or invoke node capabilities.

**Parameters**
- `action`: one of:
  - `status`
  - `describe`
  - `pending`
  - `approve`
  - `reject`
  - `notify`
  - `camera_snap`
  - `camera_list`
  - `camera_clip`
  - `photos_latest`
  - `screen_record`
  - `location_get`
  - `notifications_list`
  - `notifications_action`
  - `device_status`
  - `device_info`
  - `device_permissions`
  - `device_health`
  - `run`
  - `invoke`
- `gatewayUrl`, `gatewayToken`, `timeoutMs`: gateway/timeout options.
- `node`: target node id/name.
- `requestId`: pairing request id.
- `title`, `body`: notification text.
- `sound`: notification sound.
- `priority`: `passive`, `active`, or `timeSensitive`.
- `delivery`: `system`, `overlay`, or `auto`.
- `facing`: camera side: `front`, `back`, or `both`.
- `maxWidth`: max image width.
- `quality`: image/video quality.
- `delayMs`: delay before camera capture.
- `deviceId`: camera device id.
- `limit`: item limit.
- `duration` / `durationMs`: clip or screen-recording duration.
- `includeAudio`: include audio in recording.
- `fps`: frames per second.
- `screenIndex`: which screen to record.
- `outPath`: output path.
- `maxAgeMs`: max cached data age.
- `locationTimeoutMs`: location timeout.
- `desiredAccuracy`: `coarse`, `balanced`, or `precise`.
- `notificationAction`: `open`, `dismiss`, or `reply`.
- `notificationKey`: target notification key.
- `notificationReplyText`: reply text.
- `command`: command array for node execution.
- `cwd`: working directory for node command.
- `env`: environment variables.
- `commandTimeoutMs`: command timeout.
- `invokeTimeoutMs`: invoke timeout.
- `needsScreenRecording`: whether invoke needs screen recording.
- `invokeCommand`: named invoke command.
- `invokeParamsJson`: JSON parameters for invoke command.

---

## Scheduling / reminders

### `cron`
Manage Gateway cron jobs and wake events.

**Purpose**
- Create, update, remove, list, or run scheduled jobs.
- Schedule reminders.
- Send wake events.

**Parameters**
- `action`: `status`, `list`, `add`, `update`, `remove`, `run`, `runs`, or `wake`.
- `gatewayUrl`, `gatewayToken`, `timeoutMs`: gateway/timeout options.
- `includeDisabled`: include disabled jobs when listing.
- `job`: full job object for adding.
- `jobId` / `id`: job identifier.
- `patch`: update patch object.
- `text`: wake/system event text.
- `mode`: wake mode: `now` or `next-heartbeat`.
- `runMode`: `due` or `force`.
- `contextMessages`: number of recent messages to include, 0–10.

**Job schema**
- `name`: optional job name.
- `schedule`: when to run.
- `payload`: what to execute.
- `delivery`: optional delivery behavior.
- `sessionTarget`: `main` or `isolated`.
- `enabled`: boolean.

**Schedule kinds**
- `at`: one-shot absolute timestamp.
- `every`: recurring interval in milliseconds.
- `cron`: cron expression, optionally with timezone.

**Payload kinds**
- `systemEvent`: injects text into main session.
- `agentTurn`: runs an isolated agent task.

---

## Messaging / speech

### `message`
Send and manage messages through configured channel plugins.

**Purpose**
- Send proactive messages.
- Broadcast messages.
- Send attachments.
- React/vote/manage some channel-specific objects depending on provider support.

**Core parameters**
- `action`: currently `send`.
- `channel`: provider, e.g. `telegram`, `whatsapp`, `discord`, `slack`, `signal`, etc.
- `target` / `targets`: recipient/channel target(s).
- `accountId`: provider account id.
- `dryRun`: test without sending.
- `message`: text content.
- `effectId` / `effect`: message effect.
- `media`: media URL or local path.
- `filename`: attachment filename.
- `buffer`: base64 attachment payload.
- `contentType` / `mimeType`: attachment MIME type.
- `caption`: media caption.
- `path` / `filePath`: file attachment path.
- `replyTo`: message id to reply to.
- `threadId`: thread id.
- `asVoice`: send as voice/audio when supported.
- `silent`: send silently.
- `quoteText`: quoted reply text.
- `bestEffort`: tolerate provider limitations.
- `gifPlayback`: GIF playback option.

**Reaction / message-selection parameters**
- `messageId` / `message_id`: target message id.
- `emoji`: reaction emoji.
- `remove`: remove reaction or item where supported.
- `targetAuthor`, `targetAuthorUuid`: target author filters.
- `groupId`: group id.
- `limit`, `before`, `after`, `around`: listing/search windows.
- `fromMe`: filter own messages.
- `includeArchived`: include archived conversations.

**Poll parameters**
- `pollId`: poll id.
- `pollOptionId` / `pollOptionIds`: stable poll option ids.
- `pollOptionIndex` / `pollOptionIndexes`: 1-based option indexes.
- `pollQuestion`: poll question.
- `pollOption`: poll options.
- `pollDurationHours`: poll duration.
- `pollMulti`: allow multiple selections.

**Discord/channel-management-style parameters**
- `channelId`, `channelIds`, `guildId`, `userId`, `authorId`, `authorIds`
- `roleId`, `roleIds`, `participant`
- `emojiName`
- `stickerId`, `stickerName`, `stickerDesc`, `stickerTags`
- `threadName`, `autoArchiveMin`, `appliedTags`
- `query`
- `eventName`, `eventType`, `startTime`, `endTime`, `desc`, `location`, `durationMin`, `until`
- `reason`, `deleteDays`
- `name`, `type`, `parentId`, `topic`, `position`, `nsfw`, `rateLimitPerUser`, `categoryId`, `clearParent`
- `activityType`, `activityName`, `activityUrl`, `activityState`
- `status`

---

### `tts`
Convert text to speech.

**Purpose**
- Generate speech/audio from text.
- Audio is automatically delivered from the tool result.

**Parameters**
- `text`: text to convert to speech.
- `channel`: optional output/channel format hint, e.g. `telegram`.

---

## Gateway / OpenClaw management

### `gateway`
Restart, inspect, update, or patch OpenClaw Gateway/config.

**Purpose**
- Restart gateway.
- Inspect config schema.
- Read config.
- Apply/patch config.
- Run OpenClaw self-update when explicitly requested.

**Parameters**
- `action`: `restart`, `config.get`, `config.schema.lookup`, `config.apply`, `config.patch`, or `update.run`.
- `delayMs`: restart delay.
- `reason`: human-readable reason.
- `gatewayUrl`, `gatewayToken`, `timeoutMs`: gateway/timeout options.
- `path`: config/schema path.
- `raw`: raw config content or patch payload.
- `baseHash`: config hash for concurrency safety.
- `sessionKey`: session to notify.
- `note`: completion message after restart/update.
- `restartDelayMs`: restart delay after config changes.

---

## Sessions / agents

### `agents_list`
List OpenClaw agent ids available for `sessions_spawn` with `runtime: "subagent"`.

**Purpose**
- Discover allowed subagent ids.

**Parameters**
- None.

---

### `sessions_list`
List sessions.

**Purpose**
- Find active/recent sessions and subagents.

**Parameters**
- `kinds`: filter session kinds.
- `limit`: maximum sessions.
- `activeMinutes`: only sessions active within this many minutes.
- `messageLimit`: number of recent messages to include.

---

### `sessions_history`
Fetch message history for another session.

**Purpose**
- Inspect another session’s conversation history.

**Parameters**
- `sessionKey`: target session key.
- `limit`: maximum messages.
- `includeTools`: include tool calls/results.

---

### `sessions_send`
Send a message into another session.

**Purpose**
- Cross-session communication.
- Can address by session key, label, or agent id.

**Parameters**
- `sessionKey`: target session key.
- `label`: target session label.
- `agentId`: target agent id.
- `message`: message to send.
- `timeoutSeconds`: timeout.

---

### `sessions_spawn`
Spawn an isolated subagent or ACP coding session.

**Purpose**
- Run one-shot or persistent delegated tasks.
- Supports normal OpenClaw subagents and ACP harnesses.

**Parameters**
- `task`: task/instruction to run.
- `label`: session label.
- `runtime`: `subagent` or `acp`.
- `agentId`: agent/harness id.
- `resumeSessionId`: resume existing ACP session id.
- `model`: model override.
- `thinking`: reasoning/thinking setting.
- `cwd`: working directory.
- `runTimeoutSeconds`: timeout for run.
- `timeoutSeconds`: creation/communication timeout.
- `thread`: whether to create/use a thread-bound session.
- `mode`: `run` or `session`.
- `cleanup`: `delete` or `keep`.
- `sandbox`: `inherit` or `require`.
- `streamTo`: stream destination, e.g. `parent`.
- `attachments`: files/content to attach.
  - `name`
  - `content`
  - `encoding`: `utf8` or `base64`
  - `mimeType`
- `attachAs`: attachment mount options.
  - `mountPath`

---

### `subagents`
List, steer, or kill spawned subagents for this requester session.

**Purpose**
- Manage subagents created by this session.

**Parameters**
- `action`: `list`, `kill`, or `steer`.
- `target`: target subagent id/name.
- `message`: steering message.
- `recentMinutes`: recent time window.

---

### `session_status`
Show a `/status`-equivalent status card.

**Purpose**
- Check usage/time/cost/model status.
- Can set per-session model override.

**Parameters**
- `sessionKey`: optional target session.
- `model`: optional model override; `default` resets override.

---

## Memory tools

### `memory_search`
Search long-term and daily memory files.

**Purpose**
- Semantic search over `MEMORY.md` and `memory/*.md`.
- Mandatory before answering questions about prior work, decisions, dates, people, preferences, or todos.

**Parameters**
- `query`: search query.
- `maxResults`: maximum results.
- `minScore`: minimum relevance score.

---

### `memory_get`
Read a safe snippet from memory files.

**Purpose**
- Pull only needed lines after `memory_search`.

**Parameters**
- `path`: memory file path.
- `from`: starting line.
- `lines`: number of lines.

---

## Multi-tool wrapper

### `multi_tool_use.parallel`
Run multiple independent tool calls in parallel.

**Purpose**
- Batch unrelated tool calls that can safely happen at the same time.

**Parameters**
- `tool_uses`: array of tool calls.
  - `recipient_name`: tool name, e.g. `functions.read`.
  - `parameters`: parameters for that tool.
